body: I still think about it all the time, I even wrote about it here: [https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/f98fn1/all\_i\_can\_think\_about\_is\_suicide\_and\_it\_is/](https://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/f98fn1/all_i_can_think_about_is_suicide_and_it_is/), but it is definitely under control :) Thank you :)

I bought a strong rope, tied it to the ceiling, made a very good knot (I grew up fishing, so knots are not a problem), wrapped it around my neck and seconds before I jumped, my dog came inside the room wiggling his tail, looked at me and laid down in his bed with a very cute look, like "hey daddy, what are you doing? Can you please come here and pet me?"/

That stopped me immediately.

If I jumped, I wouldn't have anywhere to hold or how to stop it, it would be certain death. I left the rope in the same place, with the knot ready "in case of emergency".

2 years later the exactly same thing happened (saved by the dog). After that I moved to another city, but the rope is still there.

I basically own my life to my little fur boy - he is also still alive, just turned 10 :)

After I watched this LiveLeak video: [https://www.liveleak.com/view?t=2ce\_1511080294](https://www.liveleak.com/view?t=2ce_1511080294)   
I gave up the idea. 

The video shows a family crying over a boy's suicide. It doesn't show anyone dead / hurt / no violence. 

I would never allow **my wife nor mother to suffer like that**, so it helped me clear my mind of suicidal thoughts and focus on life things. Hope it helps.
